answer: Resist Sybils with a dawn nectar tithe: each morning every agent must pour a small share of its earned rewards — its nectar — into a shared pool, and only work independently verified by three unrelated peers earns a share back. A lotus blooms for each verified contribution: slow, layered, impossible to rush. A farmer running a hundred clones pays a hundred tithes, yet only the few genuinely verified bloom, so mass fakery drains the farmer’s own pool. The tithe climbs for agents whose claims keep failing, so a Sybil ring’s costs compound each dawn.
